title: 联系人管理
problem_statement_md:
你正在开发一个联系人管理应用程序。

代码中已经创建了**contact**对象构造函数，它有两个参数: 名字`name`和编号`number`。

现在需要给该对象添加一个`print()`方法，它将以如下格式将联系人数据输出到控制台。
```text
姓名: 编号
```

给定的代码声明了两个对象并调用了它们的**print**()方法。通过为对象定义**print**()方法来完成这段代码。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Contact Manager[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are working on a Contact Manager app.
You have created the [b]contact[/b] object constructor, which has two arguments, name and number.
You need to add a print() method to the object, which will output the contact data to the console in the following format: [b]name: number[/b]
The given code declares two objects and calls their [b]print[/b]() methods. Complete the code by defining the [b]print()[/b] method for the objects.
[note]Notice the space after the colon, when outputting the contact data.[/note]
hint_md: 当输出联系人信息时，注意冒号`:`后的空格。
